Add an Interactive Distance & Area Measurement Control (add_measure)

Source: R/controls.R
add_measure.Rd

Drop-in GPU equivalent of leaflet::addMeasure(). Adds an interactive measurement widget (defaulting to "bottom-right") that lets users click vertices on the map to measure geodesic path distance (m / km / mi) and geodesic polygon area (sq. m / ha / sq. km / acres) with live segment rubber-banding, double-click to finish, and 1-click Clear.

Usage

add_measure(
  map,
  position = "bottomright",
  primaryLengthUnit = "meters",
  secondaryLengthUnit = "kilometers",
  primaryAreaUnit = "sqmeters",
  secondaryAreaUnit = NULL,
  activeColor = "#38bdf8",
  completedColor = "#a855f7",
  localization = "en",
  order = 15
)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

position

Anchor position in the 9-zone layout grid (default "bottomright").

primaryLengthUnit

Primary length unit ("meters", "kilometers", "feet", "miles").

secondaryLengthUnit

Optional secondary length unit ("kilometers", "miles").

primaryAreaUnit

Primary area unit ("sqmeters", "hectares", "sqkilometers", "acres").

secondaryAreaUnit

Optional secondary area unit.

activeColor

Stroke/vertex color while actively measuring (default "#38bdf8").

completedColor

Stroke/fill color when a measurement is completed (default "#a855f7").

localization

Language code (default "en").

order

Numeric draw order within the anchor zone (default 15).

Value

Updated glmap widget or glmap_proxy.
